literal_meaning: বুড়ো আঙুল দেখানো (thumb showing or displaying the thumb)
figurative_meaning_en: To defy or mock authority, to cheat or deceive openly
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নিয়মকে বুড়ো আঙুল দেখিয়ে কাজ করল।
আইনকে বুড়ো আঙুল দেখানোর চেষ্টা করবেন না।
example_sentences_in_english: He thumbed his nose at the rules by doing it anyway.
Don't try to thumb your nose at the law.
note: The idiom refers to a gesture of showing the thumb as a sign of contempt, common in urban Bengali slang.
